hist-anc-01-c2.text: National Geographic. How the Rosetta Stone unlocked the secrets of ancient civilizations. National Geographic.
hist-anc-01-c2.quote: When Pierre-François Bouchard's men discovered the ancient stone slab that would change the world on July 19, 1799, they weren't on an archaeological dig; they were doing a last-minute construction job.
hist-anc-01-c2.claim: The Rosetta Stone, discovered in 1799, finally let scholars read hieroglyphs.
